theme: The last day ashore before the charter.
greeting: You're on your last full day in Dubrovnik, Dan, and the calendar's clear — which is the point. Everything worth doing today is dry-land prep before tomorrow's boarding, when the signal goes quiet.

needsAttention.title: Lock down the charter boarding details
needsAttention.detail: Reach the Nautilus instructor today to confirm Saturday's ~5 PM boarding time and place and the return transfer — once you're aboard the signal all but disappears.

needsAttention.title: Arrange the Cavtat transfers and checkout
needsAttention.detail: Three dry-land jobs for Sept 19–20 — the marina-to-Cavtat transfer, an early bag hold, and the 5:15 AM checkout — all need booking before Saturday, and the hotel's free-cancellation window closes Sept 15.

needsAttention.title: Provision before you board
needsAttention.detail: Cash, snacks, wine, and any gluten-free staples from Studenac or Tommy while you're still in town — much harder once the boat's underway.

needsAttention.title: Book the Florida SUV outright
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20–Oct 5 Tampa full-size SUV is no longer a hedge — book it now so you're not at a walk-up counter, jet-lagged, on a Sunday.

flagged.title: New VP, Government Affairs roles
flagged.detail: LinkedIn flagged fresh openings in your field, including a VP, Government Affairs role at The New York Times.

flagged.title: ICGN Autumn Conference in Toronto
flagged.detail: Registration is open for the November governance conference — worth a look given the board search.

flagged.title: Checkout is tomorrow at 10:30
flagged.detail: Your Dubrovnik host asked you to leave the keys on the table and message him when you leave.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters — NYT Cooking, Monocle, Alison Roman — plus retail sales and political fundraising.

recipe.title: Translucent Apple Tart
recipe.why: Early-autumn apples are at their crispest now, ideal for a tart that leans on the fruit itself.

tasks.title: Book St Pete lodging for the Sept 20–22 landing gap

acts.line: A clear calendar over the Old Port — today's real work is the errand list, not any meeting.
Provision and confirm the transfers while the shops are open and the wifi still holds.
Last night ashore; checkout is 10:30 and you board the charter tomorrow at five.
